segments.description: A value-added distributor that sells, leases, and services commercial laundry equipment, parts, and accessories for government, institutional, industrial, commercial and retail customers.
segments.evidence: As of June 30, 2026, the Company reported its results of operations through a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for purchases or leases of commercial laundry equipment, parts and accessories, and for installation, maintenance, and repair services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's primary sources of cash are sales of products and services, and borrowings under its credit facility.

changes.text: In 2026, the Company acquired Sudsies and established a new division that will be a separate operating and reportable segment for consumer garment care services.
changes.evidence: The Company has established a new division, which will be a separate operating and reportable segment, for its consumer garment care services operations and investments.
